name: Hotel Wiesenhof
beschreibung: Hotel Wiesenhof enjoys a sunny and peaceful setting in Mieders at the gateway to the picturesque Stubai Valley. Surrounded by meadows and pine forests, the hotel provides a welcoming retreat with uninterrupted views of the surrounding peaks. Cozy guest rooms and self-catering apartments feature scenic balconies and modern conveniences. After active days hiking or skiing, guests can unwind in the wellness area complete with sauna, steam bath, and relaxation rooms. The traditional restaurant serves homemade Tyrolean specialties and international dishes. The Serlesbahnen cable cars, hiking trails, and toboggan runs are all nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run hotel in Mieders in the Stubai Valley offering mountain views, a wellness area, and Tyrolean hospitality.
